markdown_sections.title: Doom Term v1.1.7
markdown_sections.markdown: Replay, an optional theme pack, loops about eleven seconds of real gameplay recorded from the shareware game's own demo by an unmodified Chocolate Doom, at 30 percent opacity with the standard grey plate; the art belongs to id Software and Doom Term is not affiliated with it. Redsky, Blue Highway, Canopy and Replay are all release assets, each with a line in SHA256SUMS.txt. See docs/doom-term/replay-theme.md. Big Fucking Replay, a second recording attached after the release, loops about nine seconds of real gameplay from the full game's data in a crowded indoor hall, firing the BFG into two Cyberdemons and a swarm of other monsters, at 25 percent opacity with BFG-green accents and the standard grey plate; the art belongs to id Software, Doom Term is not affiliated with it, and the game's data file is not included. See docs/doom-term/bfr-theme.md. The in-band agent-status helper no longer goes silent when an SSH session's terminal is owned by root with mode 0600, as under Tailscale SSH: on Linux it writes through the descriptor the agent already holds, which needs kernel 5.6 or newer and kernel.yama.ptrace_scope set to 0, and where that is refused it still reports permission_denied. Claude Code's own status bar no longer repeats the helper's Context and Session line. The helper also has a read-only setup check and explicit --diagnose delivery results; detected Linux Codex 0.160.0 shared-daemon hooks withhold reports to preserve pane isolation and need --no-daemon; invalid agy quota resets no longer crash reporting. Install the updated helper on each SSH host. See docs/doom-term/remote-agent-status.md.

markdown_sections.title: Doom Term v1.1.6
markdown_sections.markdown: A theme can now recolour the bottom status plate's stone with an optional `plate_stone` key; themes without it look exactly as before. Redsky, an optional animated theme pack with a wine-maroon plate, is attached to the release as doomterm-redsky-theme.zip. See docs/doom-term/redsky-theme.md for installation and measured cost.

markdown_sections.title: Doom Term v1.1.5
markdown_sections.markdown: The status plate holds confirmed WAITING, CONTEXT, and five-hour USAGE readings through brief pauses, incomplete agent records, and transient failures. The working mark repaints at 20 frames per second without rebuilding the workspace. Claude and Codex record reading is more resilient, including separate Codex sessions in one directory; the Python 3.6-compatible remote helpers preserve reports while an agent is idle. See docs/doom-term/remote-agent-status.md for setup and evidence.html for before/after measurements and verification limits.

markdown_sections.title: Manual installation
markdown_sections.markdown: Doom Term does not check for or install updates automatically. Install a newer package manually after saving your work and closing the application. Release notes are bundled with each build.
